notes: Doctor-gated source-native adapter for the official Cylinder3D SemanticKITTI single-scan training/inference entry. `python solution/main.py --help` and `doctor --input input` never import torch/spconv/torch_scatter and thus work without any assets; `doctor` exits 78 whenever any required file/module/CUDA device from input/manifest.json is missing, and prints a JSON report. `run`/`resume` refuse to proceed on gate failure (exit 78) or missing CUDA (exit 1) and never fabricate weights, inputs or predictions. When assets are mounted, `run` derives a debug config from the source yaml (a single epoch / <=500 iters, sequence list {00}/{08}) keeping all hyperparameters, invokes `upstream/Cylinder3D/train_cylinder_asym.py -y <cfg> -n gpu_b07_debug` as a subprocess (real gradient updates performed by upstream), then loads the produced checkpoint and runs per-point inference over sequence 08 using a generated helper that performs the official cylindrical voxelization, maps every voxel logit back to its originating source point in original scan order, and writes `output/sequences/08/predictions/*.label`. A distance-stratified per-class IoU/mIoU report is computed only over annotated points with the official learning_map applied and unlabeled excluded. Due to `assets_ready=false` in input/manifest.json none of the run/inference steps were executed on the authoring host; simulation, mock weights and CPU fallbacks were intentionally omitted.`
